name: dob-input
title: DOB Input
description: Reads the date and age back as you type and catches this year typed by habit (age 0), future dates, implausible ages, a day typed into the month box, pasted dates that read two ways and under-age sign-ups, with a fix and the date someone becomes eligible.

meta.stops: Birth year typed as this year
meta.summary: Reads a birth date and age back as it is typed and catches this year typed by habit, future dates and impossible ages, so birth dates aren't saved wrong.
meta.server: Re-check age eligibility on the server; a client-side date check can be bypassed.
catches: This year typed as the birth year (age 0)
Future dates and implausible ages (minAge, maxAge)
A day typed into the month box
Pasted dates that could be read two ways
Under-age sign-ups, with the date the person becomes eligible
limits: Plausibility checks only; it can't verify a real birth date
Field order follows the `order` prop or locale; check it matches your users
a11y: Day, month and year each have a <label>, and are described by a shared status
aria-invalid on errors; Backspace in an empty part moves to the previous part
Focus moves between parts as each one is completed
